subject: QBR: Delivery health check — decision asks & risk tracker
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: QBR: Delivery health check — decision asks & risk tracker

Team —

Ahead of next week’s QBR I ran a condensed health check on the product + engineering delivery plan for the major customer launches we’re calling out. The attached "delivery-health-deck.pdf" and the milestone sheet (launch-milestones.xlsx) reflect current ETA targets and the top risks we’re watching. High-level summary:￼

- Overall roadmap: most features are on the planned sprint cadence, but velocity is tracking ~12% under target for the two most critical launch epics.
- Key risks (top 3):
  1) Infra capacity for peak rollout (risk of degraded latency at 50k concurrent sessions) — currently mitigations are planned but not fully budgeted.
  2) Model quantization regressions on long-tail prompts — flaky in nightly regressions, impacts quality SLOs.
  3) Third-party integration (Acme SSO + VectorOps reranker) has a staggered timeline that could push final integration test past our soft freeze.

Decision asks (need decisions by end of business Friday, 2027-06-18):
- Approve a hard code freeze date for the flagship region: propose 2027-06-30. (owner: Irene)
- Commit $120k of contingency for burst GPU capacity and ops on-call for 6 weeks post-launch. (owner: Finance + Marcus)
- Approve reduced CANARY rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% (owner: Karthik/Marcus)

Please review the deck and the milestones file. I want explicit ack/nack on the three asks plus any additional high-likelihood risks you want added to the prod-risk-log.csv. If you have a hard blocker that will change the freeze date, flag it in-line and propose an alternate date.

Attachments: delivery-health-deck.pdf, launch-milestones.xlsx

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Delivery health check — decision asks & risk tracker

Irene —

Thanks for the concise summary and the asks. Quick engineering readout against each point:￼

- Velocity: We shipped 6 of the 8 critical stories for the launch epic in the last sprint; remaining two are blocked by a flaky perf test (INF-4512) that we traced to an LRU eviction bug. Team estimate: 3 working days to fix + 2 days of QA. We can make the 06-30 freeze if the fix lands by 06-21. (owner: Marcus / ENG core)

- Infra capacity: Our baseline reserved fleet covers steady-state but not the 50k concurrent peak in the flagship region. The infra-capacity-plan.pdf I attached outlines two options:
  A) Reserve additional 8 A100-equivalent slots (2–3 week lead, estimated $95k) — safest but procurement/time heavy.
  B) Enable cross-region burst and auto-shift traffic during peak windows (requires ops playbook and new routing rule) — lower cost (~$40k ops + 8k config work) but operationally riskier.

Recommend we approve option B as the contingency path and keep option A as emergency fallback. This reduces the immediate ask to ~$48k. Will need a finance signoff.

- Canary rollout: I support the conservative cadence (10/30/70/100) but propose adding an intermediate 50% step between 30% and 70% for one metric-critical route (reranker service) — keeps risk low for scoring regressions.

- Integration (Acme SSO / VectorOps): I pinged Sarah Cho at Acme earlier today to confirm their SSO rollout window; she said they can complete SSO cert by 06-25 but wants a validation run the week of 06-28. That pushes our full integration smoke test to 06-29, which is within the soft freeze window but tight. I copied her confirmation below.

Attachments: infra-capacity-plan.pdf

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Engineering, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Delivery health check — decision asks & risk tracker

Folks —

Quick platform notes that affect the freeze and canary plan:￼

- Model quantization/regression: The nightly regression failures are concentrated on a set of long-tail prompts when using 4-bit quantization on sequence lengths > 3k. We have a short-term patch that disables aggressive quant paths for those sequences; it costs ~8% CPU increase but avoids output drift. Recommend we ship the patch as a config flag so we can flip post-launch if we need cost back. (owner: Karthik / runtime team)

- KV cache warm-up: Cold caches will significantly skew p95 latency on day-0 traffic spikes. We should include a KV warm-up plan in the ops playbook (pre-warm top 10k keys) and include a monitoring dashboard for cache hit-rate — I can drop a dashboard link into the drive.

- Canary cadence: I echo Marcus on adding an additional 50% step for the reranker route. For the rest of routes we can do (10/30/50/70/100) in two business days per step with a fast rollback hook. That timeline still keeps us inside the 06-30 freeze if the LRU fix lands 06-21.

- Integration testing: I reached out to Daniel at VectorOps to confirm end-to-end test harness compatibility; he expects a compatibility patch by 06-22. If both Acme and VectorOps meet their dates, our integration test on 06-29 is doable. If either slips, we need to move the soft freeze.

Related links: JIRA INF-4512 (LRU eviction), INF-4610 (quant regression), and a draft ops playbook in Drive.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

All —

Thanks for the fast inputs. Capturing decisions and next steps so QBR prep can proceed cleanly:￼

Decisions (taken):
- Freeze date approved: 2027-06-30 (Irene).
- Contingency funding approved with adjusted ask: authorize up to $50k for the cross-region burst approach (Marcus will coordinate exact chargeback with Finance).
- Canary cadence approved with extra 50% step for reranker route (Karthik/Marcus).

Action items (owners / due):
- Marcus: LRU eviction fix landed and merged by 2027-06-21 EOD; if not met, escalate to Irene immediately.
- Karthik: Push runtime config flag for quant path by 2027-06-22 and provide dashboard link for KV warm-up by 2027-06-24.
- Marcus + Ops: Finalize ops playbook for burst routing and pre-warm plan; add to Drive folder by 2027-06-24.
- Irene: Final decision note and QBR slide updates by 2027-06-25.

I’ve scheduled a 30-minute dry run for the QBR readout on Monday 2027-06-28 at 09:00 PT — calendar invite will go out. Sarah from Acme will join the integration portion and Daniel from VectorOps will join the tech validation slot. If any owner thinks the timelines above are infeasible, flag now.

I will update the prod-risk-log.csv and the delivery deck with these decisions and the new mitigations. Please add any residual risks to the CSV before EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
